……长官我！
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan Training Grounds
大观园 演武场

dataList.content:
Today's lesson...
今天要教给你们的是……

... will cover intelligence acquisition. In other words, men, you will learn how to gain information from people.
信息获取法。即从他人处获得所需信息的方法。

Hey, I'm pretty good at that.
我对此还挺有自信的。
dataList.title:

鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You just have to turn them to your side. By being generous with my spending, by setting a good example as a superior... they'll eventually open up.
将人们纳入麾下。花点银子，以上位者身份树立榜样……最终他们就会响应号召的。
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Foolishness!
一派胡言！

Eh?!
欸？！
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
That is among the worst strategies I've ever had the displeasure of hearing. Do you not see how wasteful it is to spend the limited military budget, how wasteful it is to spend so much precious time trying to butter them over?
实属下策中的下策……竟将有限的军费挪作他用，还如此浪费黄金般宝贵的作战时间。

The most efficient means of obtaining intelligence is...
最有效的方法是……

... torture.
拷问。

... T-torture?!
拷、拷问！？

Hah! I'd say that's the worst strategy I've ever had the displeasure of hearing. I'd rather not waste my clan's strength on something so utterly useless like that. Besides, if you end up accidentally killing them—
哈！这反而才是下策吧。将人力资源浪费在这种事上实在可惜。而且，万一对方死了的话……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Foolishness, foolishness!
一派胡言，一派胡言！

Jeez! Can you stop saying that word?!
什么啊！为什么从刚才开始就这么吵啊？！
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
How simplistic... and disappointing.
天真……而可悲的想法。

Your imagination falls short! If that is all you can think of when you hear the word "torture"...
如果将想象力仅局限于一个单词之中，未免太过狭隘……

... then, this unit!
这支大部队！

Uh, this isn't exactly a military unit—
那个，并不是部队……

Ahem, then, this Hongyuan may indeed be beyond your ability to lead!
咳咳，鸿园领导者的重任！你可否担当！

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
W-well, I'm waiting. Get on with your lesson.
那、那到底要怎么办啊。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
The mention of Hongyuan seemed to put Xichun in a thoughtful mood, as she stopped arguing and began focusing on class.
……当提到鸿园之名时，惜春便沉静下来，仿佛陷入沉思般专注地聆听着奥提斯的话。

The most effective method of torture isn't physical—things like waterboarding... electrocution... are all inferior.
属上策的拷问，并非水刑……电刑这类摧残肉体的手段。

Today, you will learn the torture of language. With this method, you will always find the answer you want.
而是迫使对方吐露出你想要的答案的，言语的拷问。

Use speechcraft to entrap their minds, slowly constrict around them...
将其精神渐渐围困，步步紧逼……

Gulp.
咕噜。

... and let them take brief sighs of relief every time they give you an answer.
反复进行每次给出回答后便稍作放松的技巧。

That, cadets, is what you will be learning today.
学员们，从今日起你们将开始学习这项技巧。

To your positions, cadets.
各练习生，就位。
